data.text: Visit 2 may occur as soon as the criteria for Visit 1 are confirmed. At Visit 2, screening laboratory results will be reviewed to confirm eligibility. Visit 3 to occur no sooner than 18 days after Visit 1.

On all fasting visits, study participants are required to report to the site in a fasting condition, after at least 8 hours without eating, drinking (except water), or performing any significant physical activity. Additionally, the participant should not take their study intervention before the fasting visit. If a participant is adversely affected by the fasting condition, they are allowed to eat; however, specific study procedures need to be completed while fasting.
If a participant attends a fasting visit in the non-fasting state, reschedule the visit at a time within the allowable visit interval.
The only procedure performed for these visits is PK sample collection.

data.text: For early discontinuation that occurs before the last visit in treatment period, see the activities listed for ED in the SoA.

data.text: A posttreatment safety follow-up visit will occur approximately 4 weeks following the last treatment period visit. Participants who have discontinued study intervention early and are only willing to come back for Visit 11 (Week 40) are not required to complete a safety follow-up visit if they have been off of study intervention for at least 28 days (see Section 7.1.1).
Visit procedures may be conducted over more than 1 day if all activities are completed within the allowed visit tolerance period of each visit.
Unscheduled visits may occur as needed.

The overall rationale for the changes implemented in the amendment is to: add new AESI of 'malnutrition and inadequate fluid intake' and update the title and text for AESI of 'ketoacidosis due to inadequate nutritional intake and other types of metabolic acidosis and ketosis'; provide more detailed guidance on recommending, monitoring, and managing nutritional intake and hydration; update criteria for dose modification; and include adjudication of urgent visit for heart failure.
data.sourceSection: Protocol Amendment Summary of Changes Table

data.text: Added a note in Inclusion Criterion 8 to address the usage of gender-neutral terms (AMAB and AFAB) in the document. For clarification and consistency with TRANSCEND T2D protocols.
Removed the word 'clinically significant' from Exclusion Criterion 22. Clarification to avoid ambiguity.
Defined study intervention in Exclusion Criterion 36 as retatrutide, placebo, or an active comparator.
Updated calcitonin units from 'ng/L' to 'pg/mL (Conventional) and pmol/L (SI)' in Exclusion Criterion 24 and in Section 8.3.3.8. To align with central lab reporting.
data.sourceSection: Amendment Summary - Section 5.2 Exclusion Criteria and Section 8.3.3.8

data.text: Added the word 'in a blinded fashion' for all dose adjustments managed through IWRS.

data.description: Original Protocol for Study J1I-MC-GZBY - A Phase 3, Randomized, Multicenter, Double-Blind Study to Investigate the Efficacy and Safety of Retatrutide Once Weekly Compared with Placebo in Adult Participants with Type 2 Diabetes and Inadequate Glycemic Control with Diet and Exercise Alone (TRANSCEND-T2D-1)

Protocol Amendment (a) for Study J1I-MC-GZBY electronically signed and approved by Lilly on 17 Feb 2025 GMT. Changes include: addition of new AESI of malnutrition and inadequate fluid intake; updated AESI title for ketoacidosis; more detailed guidance on nutritional intake and hydration monitoring; updated dose modification criteria; inclusion of adjudication of urgent visit for heart failure; and multiple clarifications to inclusion/exclusion criteria. Document ID: VV-CLIN-133434, IND: 145825.
